questions.question: Under Article 5, what three specific conditions render the exercise of a legally recognized right unlawful?
questions.ground_truth: The exercise of a right is unlawful in three cases: (1) if the sole aim of exercising the right is to cause harm to another, (2) if the interests intended to be achieved are out of proportion to the harm caused to another, or (3) if the interests intended to be achieved are unlawful.
